integrity: Exact proof and exhaustive finite classification with standalone rational-arithmetic reproducer; previously known mean and covariance identities are cited rather than claimed as new. The originality comparison does not establish global absence of prior results.
limitations: Deterministic nonempty binary incidence arrays, uniform sampling of sites without replacement, fixed common species occupancy multiset; the four-orbit classification applies only at seven species-plus-site vertices. No claim for noisy observations, unequal effort, or universal biodiversity distributions.
title: Sharp seven-vertex threshold for variance reversals in incidence-based species accumulation
